institution: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

app_fee.value: No PhD application fee is stated on NTNU's PhD admission pages or 2026 PhD regulations; PhD candidates are exempt from international tuition fees.

fee_waiver.value: No PhD application fee or fee waiver is stated on NTNU's PhD admission pages.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated on NTNU's PhD admission pages or 2026 PhD regulations.

toefl_min.value: NTNU's central PhD pages and 2026 PhD regulations set no university-wide TOEFL minimum (the general TOEFL 90 / 4.5 page covers master's and external course admission, while PhD vacancies or faculties may set their own requirements).

ielts_min.value: NTNU's central PhD pages and 2026 PhD regulations set no university-wide IELTS minimum (the general IELTS 6.5 page covers master's and external course admission, while PhD vacancies or faculties may set their own requirements).

english_waiver.value: NTNU's central PhD pages and 2026 PhD regulations state no university-wide English test or English-medium degree waiver rule for PhD admission.

notes: Checked PhD admission and financing (https://www.ntnu.edu/phd/admission-and-financing), PhD application portal page (https://www.ntnu.edu/phd/application-phdprogramme), PhD regulations page (https://www.ntnu.edu/phd/regulations) and the 3 Feb 2026 English PhD Regulations PDF, plus tuition fees (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/tuition-fees, which exempts PhD students from tuition fees). None state a PhD application fee, GRE policy, or university-wide PhD English test rule; 'no application fee' and TOEFL 90 / IELTS 6.5 statements on ntnu.edu apply to master's/exchange/external-course admission rather than PhD admission. Old URL https://www.ntnu.edu/phd/application-for-a-phd-programme returned 404 (now /phd/application-phdprogramme).
